profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is listed in this record as a public company headquartered in Redwood City, California, trading under the ticker AI, with SEC CIK 0001577526. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it, and the only litigation-related figure held is a California exposure count of 281.

The website content associated with the company does not describe C3.ai. It describes Air Liquide, which it calls a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare. That material states Air Liquide serves 4.3 million customers and patients across 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees, and that Air Liquide, the École normale supérieure and its Foundation announced the creation of a research chair titled "Artificial intelligence for chemistry and through chemistry."

Beyond the corporate registration details and the California count, the record contains no product or litigation information specific to C3.ai, so its AI offerings and market position cannot be described from this material.
